code:
import pandas as pd
months = ["Янв", "Фев", "Мар", "Апр", "Май", "Июн", "Июл", "Авг", "Сен"]
heads = {}
sums = {}
for sheet in ["План","Факт"]:
    raw = pd.read_excel("zerno_finance.xlsx",sheet_name=sheet,header=None)
    head = raw.index[raw.iloc[:,0]=="Код"][0]
    heads[sheet] = int(head)
    body = raw.iloc[head+1:].copy()
    body.columns = raw.iloc[head]
    body = body[body["Код"].notna() & (body["Код"]!="Итого")].set_index("Код")
    sums[sheet] = body[months].apply(pd.to_numeric).sum(axis=1).round(1)
pf = pd.DataFrame({"план":sums["План"],"факт":sums["Факт"]})
expect: Ожидаю выполнение условия, результат проверяется до анализа.

import pandas as pd
def clean_with_log(raw):
    log = [("загрузка",len(raw))]
    df = raw.drop_duplicates().copy()
    log.append(("полные дубли",len(df)))
    df["client_id"] = df.client_id.str.strip().str.upper()
    log.append(("нормализация",len(df)))
    df = df.sort_values("signup_date").drop_duplicates("client_id",keep="last").reset_index(drop=True)
    log.append(("свежие",len(df)))
    return df,log
df,log = clean_with_log(pd.read_csv("clients_raw.csv"))
log
